description: Extract IP addresses from specific types and store in expanded.ip (skipping values normalisation found invalid, which the ip field would reject along with the whole attribute)

script.source: if (ctx.type == 'ip-src' || ctx.type == 'ip-dst') { if (ctx.validation_issues != null && (ctx.validation_issues.contains('invalid-ip') || ctx.validation_issues.contains('invalid-cidr'))) { return; } if (ctx.expanded == null) { ctx.expanded = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.value.contains('/')) { ctx.expanded.ip_range = ctx.value; } else { ctx.expanded.ip = ctx.value; } }
